name: Shadow Clothing
body:
School illusion (shadow); Level arcanist 1, bard 1, medium 1, mesmerist 1, occultist 1, spiritualist 1, psychic 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1; Focus sybarite 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (mundane versions of the items being created)

EFFECT

Range Close
Target One outfit
Duration 1 day/level
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create an outfit, or alter an existing outfit, using material from the Shadow Plane, with jewelry and other accessories to match. If an outfit is altered, the new form retains any magical properties, but any mundane properties are suppressed for the duration, replaced by those of the new form it takes. The new outfit’s hardness, hit points and mundane numerical effects are halved compared to a real one. It may be created with the broken condition, but the condition and its requisite damage cannot be repaired if it is. When it or a part of it is destroyed, if a real outfit was altered to create it, that outfit, or its respective piece when applicable, takes its place with an equal amount of damage. When cast directly on a creature or clothing being worn by a creature, the shadow clothing matches the creature’s taste as closely as possible for an outfit of that kind unless you choose otherwise. Subsequent castings of shadow clothing on the same outfit refresh the duration. Each time can alter the outfit again. Shadow clothing can be made permanent with a permanency spell. The cost equals half of what a real version of the items would be worth.

Shadow Clothing Adaptation

Level bard 4, medium 4, mesmerist 4, occultist 4, spiritualist 4, psychic 4, shaman 4; Focus sybarite 4
Duration 1 hour/level

DESCRIPTION

As shadow clothing, except as noted above, and you may choose a skill associated with the outfit being made at the time of casting. The outfit grants its wearer the skill as a class skill, along with ranks in the skill equal to half your level or its own level, whichever is lower. This does not stack with any skill ranks or class skill bonuses the wearer has. If the outfit being made does not match the wearer’s culture, ranks granted are reduced by 2, but it grants the benefits of the cultural adaptation spell. If a creature wears more than one of these outfits at the same time, only the one worn on top applies these benefits. This spell cannot be made permanent.
